We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1.

We need to find appropriate templates. Could manually design: disconnection 1: amide bond formation between an aniline (anisidine) and a carboxylic acid derivative (maybe acid chloride). So forward reaction is Friedel-Crafts acylation? Actually target has an amide linking anisidine (methoxy phenyl) to heterocycle. So retrosynthesis: break amide to give aniline (COc1cccc(NH2)c1) and acyl component: c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)C(=O)Cl? Actually amide carbonyl attached to heterocycle. So step1: disconnection of amide via reverse amide formation (i.e., use acyl chloride + amine). So template: amide formation (functional groups broken: amine, acyl chloride formed? Actually forward: acyl chloride + amine -> amide + HCl. So broken: halide (Cl) formed: amine. So we need template that forms amide from acyl chloride and amine. Use search with functional_groups_broken: ['acyl chloride'] and formed: ['amide']. Already tried and got empty. Maybe use functional_groups_broken: ['alkyl halide'] and formed: ['amide']? Let's try.
